description: Deterministic fixture incidents for retrieval/QA benchmarks. Synthetic data only.

incidents.title: payment-api checkout outage from connection pool exhaustion

sections.text: Checkout requests to payment-api failed for 38 minutes. Roughly 12% of customers saw HTTP 500 errors when submitting orders.
14:02 deploy completed. 14:09 elevated error rate alert fired. 14:15 incident declared. 14:40 rollback finished and error rates recovered.
The root cause was a new ORM setting in the deploy that leaked database connections, exhausting the payment-api connection pool under load.
Engineers rolled back the deploy, restarted the payment-api workers to clear the exhausted pool, and added a connection-leak regression test.

incidents.title: regional DNS resolution failure in eu-west

sections.text: Services in eu-west could not resolve internal hostnames for 22 minutes, causing intermittent timeouts for European users.
A misconfigured resolver ACL pushed by automation blocked queries from the eu-west subnet, caused by a wrong CIDR range in the change.
The on-call reverted the resolver ACL change and added CIDR validation to the network automation pipeline.

incidents.title: notification delays from kafka consumer lag

sections.text: Push notifications were delayed up to 45 minutes while the kafka consumer group fell behind by 9 million messages.
A schema change doubled message size, and consumer batch settings caused repeated rebalances triggered by session timeouts.
Increased consumer session timeout, scaled out the consumer group from 6 to 12 instances, and drained the backlog overnight.

incidents.title: session store outage from redis memory eviction

sections.text: Users were randomly logged out for two hours because session keys were evicted from redis.
A new feature cached large payloads in the shared redis cluster, pushing memory past the eviction threshold with allkeys-lru enabled.
Moved the feature cache to a dedicated redis instance and set maxmemory-policy to noeviction for the session store.

incidents.title: webhook delivery failures from expired TLS certificate

sections.text: Outbound webhooks failed for 3 hours with TLS handshake errors, affecting 240 integration partners.
The webhook egress proxy certificate expired because the renewal cron job had been disabled during an earlier maintenance window.
Issued a new certificate, re-enabled the renewal cron, and added expiry monitoring with a 30-day alert threshold.

incidents.title: search indexer crashloop from kubernetes OOM kills

sections.text: Search index freshness degraded to 6 hours stale while the indexer pods were OOM killed in a crashloop.
A library upgrade increased heap usage about 40%, exceeding the pod memory limit of 2Gi.
Raised the memory limit to 4Gi, tuned the JVM heap, and added a canary stage that watches container memory before full rollout.

incidents.title: login failures from misconfigured rate limiter

sections.text: About 30% of login attempts were throttled with HTTP 429 responses for 50 minutes.
A config push set the per-IP login limit to 5 per hour instead of 5 per minute, caused by a unit mismatch in the limiter config.
Corrected the limiter window, added config schema validation, and required a second reviewer for limiter changes.

incidents.title: stale pricing shown after CDN cache poisoning

sections.text: European customers saw prices that were 24 hours stale for most of a day.
An origin header change made the CDN treat pricing responses as cacheable for 86400 seconds due to a missing no-store directive.
Purged the CDN cache, restored the no-store header, and added a contract test for cache-control on pricing endpoints.

incidents.title: mobile clients logged out by token validation bug

sections.text: All mobile sessions were invalidated at once, forcing 2 million users to log in again.
A refactor changed the JWT clock-skew check from less-than-or-equal to less-than, rejecting tokens minted in the same second.
Reverted the comparison operator, added unit tests around token boundary timestamps, and staged the re-release behind a 1% canary.

incidents.title: report exports failing from object storage policy change

sections.text: Scheduled report exports failed for 12 hours with access denied errors.
A bucket policy tightened during a security review removed the s3:PutObject permission for the reporting role.
Restored the missing permission scoped to the reports prefix and added an integration test that writes a canary object.

incidents.title: read replica failover storm during primary upgrade

sections.text: Write traffic was unavailable for 9 minutes and read latency tripled for an hour during the failover storm.
02:00 maintenance began. 02:04 primary demoted. 02:05 two replicas raced to promote. 02:13 quorum restored with a single primary.
The failover orchestrator had a race condition triggered by overlapping health-check timeouts, promoting two replicas simultaneously.
Patched the orchestrator to serialize promotions with a distributed lock and lengthened health-check timeouts during maintenance.

incidents.title: checkout regression from stale feature flag cleanup

sections.text: Gift card payments failed for 4 hours after a flag cleanup deploy removed a code path still in use.
The cleanup assumed the legacy gift card flow was fully migrated, but 7% of traffic still depended on the old flag branch.
Restored the legacy branch behind the flag, added traffic analytics to the flag dashboard, and blocked cleanup of flags with live traffic.
